# Core Business Rules Checklist: Reimplementar o núcleo da farm

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, clarity, and consistency of the core business requirements for the Farm 3D 3D printing farm ERP/MES (production lot splitting, FIFO material reservation, printer/lote state machines, quote-to-order lifecycle, cost estimation, and role-based access).
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements quality dimensions.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are rollback/undo requirements defined for production lot release when material reservation partially fails? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the "periodic processing" mechanism — how it is triggered (cron, manual, scheduler) and what happens if it runs while another operation is in progress? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what happens when the 3D file referenced by a Product cannot be loaded (missing, corrupted, permission error)? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities – Arquivo 3D]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the interaction between production release and sales order state — does releasing a lot change the SalesOrder state, and if so, how? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for what happens when a user without a role (no Admin/Vendas/Produção/Compras/Operador) attempts an action not covered by FR-001? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the calendar configuration scope — is it a single farm-wide calendar or per-printer? Edge Cases imply "configurável" but FR-023 says "o calendário vigente" (singular). [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for how the "fictitious data" mark (examples_are_fictional) propagates to the UI — who controls the flag, and does it apply retroactively to stored examples? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for concurrent access to the same StockItem by two production lot releases — is there a concurrency control strategy (pessimistic lock, optimistic concurrency, application-level guard)? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the term "incompatible" in FR-013 clearly defined — does it refer only to the printer's material compatibility list, or also to operational state, or both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the rounding rule from the Edge Cases ("no centavo mais próximo, metade para cima") specified as an FR and applied in the cost estimation formula (FR-023)? [Clarity, Edge Case §rounding]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "periodic processing" defined with a clear trigger mechanism and execution model — scheduled job, manual command, event-driven? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the distinction between "quantidade em quilos" (purchase order) and "peso em gramas" (receipt) consistently specified for all fields that involve both units across entities? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities – Pedido de compra, Lote de material]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "saldo livre" precisely defined as a formula (available = quantity − reserved) and is this formula repeated in every requirement that references it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the behavior when "peças por prancha" is zero or missing specified with a concrete validation error message or code? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the audit trail format fully specified — what fields, what granularity of state representation (enum value, human text, before/after snapshot)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Do the FR-007 periodic processing requirements ("MUST NOT expirar rejeitado nem pedido gerado") align with the US3 acceptance scenario 6 which states rejected/expired budgets do not expire — is "pedido gerado" the same state as "rejeitado"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007 vs US3 §AC-6]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the US1 AC-2 and US3 AC-4 both say "the order is not created" — is the error response/format consistently defined across acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §US1 AC-2 vs US3 AC-4]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the role matrix internally consistent — does every FR that mentions a role action match the role definitions in FR-001 and the Key Entities section? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001 through FR-026]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the US5 acceptance scenarios for printer state transitions align with the FR-014 "two-state principle" and FR-015 printer return-to-available requirements — are there no contradictions between "concluir → aguarda retirada" and "máquina continua ocupada"? [Consistency, Spec §US5 vs FR-014 vs FR-015]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the edge case rules consistent with each other — "dois lotes não ocupam a mesma impressora ao mesmo tempo" vs "duas conclusões são recusadas" — is there a clear priority order? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the "lote" terminology consistently disambiguated — "lote de produção" vs "lote de material" vs "lote de compra" — and is there a rule preventing the bare term "lote" in user-facing text as stated in the Vocabulário? [Consistency, Spec §Vocabulário vs FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Can "em menos de 5 minutos" (SC-001) be objectively measured given that it includes multiple user actions across two different roles? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the success criteria quantified with thresholds for "atrasado" (SC-007) — is a single day late "atrasado" or only N days? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK024 Can SC-008 be objectively verified — "apontar a marca de dado fictício sem ajuda" is a user behavior metric, not a system behavior metric. Is this a requirements test or a UX test? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK025 Is SC-006's "exatamente no peso recebido" verifiable — does it exclude fees, shrinkage, or rounding differences? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the complete lifecycle of a Purchase Order from rascunho through cancelado — specifically, can a rascunho PO be edited before being sent? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for partial quote lines — if a quote has 3 lines and only one is released, what happens to the other two? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for what happens when a PrintRun fails with "reimpressão" and the production lot's original material lot is now empty (all consumed by the first run)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for the case where a printer becomes unavailable mid-execution (power failure, hardware fault) — is this a "falha" event or a separate event? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §US5]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for what happens when the same SalesOrder is generated from two different quotes simultaneously (race condition)? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK031 Are recovery flow requirements defined for what happens when periodic processing crashes mid-execution (e.g., expires half the quotes)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 Is the edge case "peças por prancha menores que 1" fully covered in FR-011's release logic — is the error a validation failure or a silent adjustment? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the edge case "impressora recém-cadastrada e ativa entra na capacidade" aligned with the FR-013 rule that only available printers receive lots — does a new printer start as available or does it need a preparation step? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases vs FR-013]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the rounding edge cases ("Gramas reservadas guardam até três casas e não arredondam para esconder falta de saldo") specified in the FR-012 reservation requirement? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the edge case "orçamento sem validade não expira" explicitly tested against the FR-007 periodic processing rule? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the "moeda" and "gramas na operação" currency/precision edge cases reflected in the financial entities (Fatura, Pagamento) requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-021]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK037 Are explicit performance requirements defined for the dashboard query (FR-022) — the plan mentions "centenas de milissegundos" but the spec does not include this in any FR. [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK038 Are security requirements defined for the password hashing algorithm — the constitution mentions "guardada de forma irreversível" and the plan says "scrypt", but is this specified as an FR? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities – Usuário]
- [ ] CHK039 Are accessibility requirements specified — the plan mentions a Vue SPA but accessibility (WCAG, keyboard navigation) is not mentioned in any FR or edge case. [Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 Are data retention and privacy requirements specified — the spec mentions "Retenção de dados pessoais segue a política do controlador" but is this expressed as a verifiable requirement? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK041 Are backup and disaster recovery requirements specified — the plan uses SQLite in a single file, but there are no FRs about data protection or recovery. [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK042 Is the assumption "Kanban é interno" validated — does this mean there is no external Kanban board integration, or that the kanban board is not a user-facing feature? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the assumption "Tempo e material nascem do perfil de produção digitado" validated — does the system accept any values from the user for time/grams per plate, or are there limits? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK044 Are the calendar assumptions ("segunda a sexta, 08:00–18:00") expressed as configurable requirements rather than hardcoded defaults? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK045 Is the dependency on external 3D file storage defined — the plan says "arquivo 3D em disco" but the FRs do not specify storage location, access control, or lifecycle of these files. [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK046 Is the assumption "Usuários iniciais existem para os five papéis" — are seed/user creation requirements defined for all five roles in FR-002? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK047 [Conflict] FR-007 says "MUST NOT expirar rejeitado" but the Constitution §V states that FR-025 requires fictional data examples to be marked — is there a conflict between the CHECK constraint `examples_are_fictional` with `CHECK (= 1)` (plan line 50) and the ability to set it via API configuration (as noted in previous analysis)? [Conflict]
- [ ] CHK048 [Ambiguity] FR-008 says "O pedido nasce confirmado" but US3 AC-7 says a manually created order starts in "confirmação pendente" — is the difference between "generated from quote" vs "created manually" clearly stated as the reason? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008 vs US3 AC-7]
- [ ] CHK049 [Ambiguity] FR-013 uses "incompatível com o material" but the US1 AC-3 scenario says "impressora cuja lista de materiais não contém o material do lote" — is "incompatível" defined as list-membership or as a computed property? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013 vs US1 AC-3]
- [ ] CHK050 [Conflict] FR-005 says "limite de horas de manutenção maior que zero" (implied mandatory) but US2 AC-3 says "quando grava uma impressora sem limite de horas de manutenção, o cadastro é recusado" — is the limit a required field or is there a default? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005 vs US2 AC-3]
- [ ] CHK051 [Ambiguity] FR-014 says the lot and printer states must change independently, but US5 AC-3 says "concluir → lote aguarda retirada e impressora aguarda retirada" — are these the same state value (e.g., "aguardaRetirada") on both entities, which could tempt an implementation to derive one from the other? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014 vs US5 AC-3]
- [ ] CHK052 [Conflict] The Vocabulário section forbids the bare term "lote" where production lot and material lot can be confused, but FR-012 uses "gramas do lote" without qualification — is this a vocab violation in the FR text itself? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012 vs §Vocabulário]
